notes.title: We are sad to annouce you the end of pandum online :(
notes.notes: [p]The game server which started running in 2006 is quite old and require a complete technical upgrade, unfortunately, Pandum didn't meet the  success that would make this investment possible.[/p][p][/p][p]We really want to thank all the players who have interrested in it and we hope to be able to reboot this world under a shape or another in a close future.[/p][p][/p][p]Server will definitely close on [b]December 31, 2025[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26287798/a20e28e5bdbb7324b414b5f3a408a5c44cd3ed08.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
Bug fixes

No more random endless connection screen

- Bug fixes
- Periodic bot events
[list]
[*] Find the healer and team up with her
[*] Escort Kenny to camp and he will help you

notes.title: Version 1.12.0
notes.notes:
-Target system enhancement
-Hell gate 1 map
-Hell gate 2 map
-Troll tower respawn cool down
-Ranking bonus has been lowered (1%/point)
-HP crystal effect is now +25% max HP

-New NPC in town selling arena tickets and HP potions
-Idling players are now stuck to mobile platforms
-Server security enhanced (RSA + map switch)
-Web server performance has been improved (NIO based)
-Informations in character hall on LD/big screens
-Ruins map minor changes
-Bug fixes
. Potions and rings glitch has been fixed
. Stats are displayed with accuracy
. Enhanced equipments after bought are displayed correctly
. Skin death issue with shop
. Player selection after death issue
. Purity remove debuff only
. Mob AI (Zender, Zaar ...)
. Voice messages on android
. Fix blinking animations when moving

-Dragon claw to enhance armors
-Card game offers dragon claw
-Map Canyon (access from Camp)
-Map Temple (access from Canyon)
-Map Sanctuary (access from Canyon)
-Talent merchant (X2 price to NPC)
-Orange weapons (sword and pyrodactyl) lv80 droppable on Hares
-Balancing
. Mobs attack and defense
. Damages are more statistic dependent
. Max HP are more level dependent
. HP potions/Elixir effect has been increased
. Force and speed of basic attack has been increased
-GUI improvement
. One shot notification
. team member selected directly from name on right
. Skill/inventory slide/click
. Statistic icons

-Map troll fortress I (access from battle field)
-Map troll fortress II (instance)
-New quests on Spectra, King wurm and Troll fortress
-Map stone field (access from battle field and ruins)
-Map Burial (access from stone field)
-Story line splash on character creation
-Relic items droppable in blue zones to increase faith ans stats related to divinity (see quest in council)
-Blue weapons (sword and pyrodactyl) lv70 droppable on General
-Card game offers green TRex Mount reward
-Trex mounts (green and red)
-Orange armor (DPS) droppable and craftable

notes.title: PvP tournaments
notes.notes:
We would like to periodically (each sunday) run a PvP tournament.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26287798/fabd83c3192c92a67e90bd3ff510ba79b6589661.png[/img]
Depending on number of people interested, this could be 1 vs 1 until 3 vs 3 round using standard arena rules. Reward for winners can be variable (rare demon pet or other stuffs...)

We want to try tournament mode as soon as possible (maybe tomorrow), but we need to know how many people are interrested and what is the best hour to start event (8pm CET ?).
If you want to participate, please send an email to info@pandum.net with your account name and eventually the other players you would like to be teamed up.

Thank you to all players !

notes.title: Important server update
notes.notes:
- New shop items : skins and character stat reset (work in progress)
- Bug fix : Crash if a hit have too much Damages
- Bug fix : toxic puddle cannot be casted on party member anymore
- Fire ball balancing : damage bonus have been decreased
- Bug fix : King Eye drop weapons as it was supposed to do
- Weapon enhancement : number of dragon eyes required is increased with weapon lvl
- XP pot balancing : XP has been reduced
- Boss balancing : King Eye and King Wurm are quicker to return on their spawn spot to regen.
- New feature : Arena tournament mode has been integrated (an announcement will be done tomorrow). 
- Bug fix : avatar issue on HD screen 

New map release has been postponed to next month in order to fix important bugs first and balance game play.
